payload.comment: The architecture_research artefact is well-structured, internally consistent, and appropriately calibrated to the 28×28×3 / 9-class / ~90k-sample regime. Key strengths: (1) The spatial-resolution constraint is correctly identified as the dominant design factor, with concrete guidance to limit downsampling to at most 28→14→7. (2) Transformer guidance is quantitatively grounded (patch_size=4 → 49 tokens; d_model ≤ 192; 4–6 layers for compact variant), and the token-starvation risk is explicitly flagged. (3) Parametrization priorities (LR, weight decay, batch size, dropout, class-weighted/focal loss) are specific, range-bounded, and differentiated between CNN and transformer families. (4) test_metrics_used is correctly false. (5) Evidence sources (ViT, DeiT, Nature Sci. Reports) are relevant and real. (6) All structured values (image shape, class counts, channel stats, split sizes, imbalance ratio) are consistent with the data_profile, split_manifest, and representation_plan artefacts. Minor observations (already flagged in upstream stages, not blocking): the data_profile.ambiguity_risks narrative contains a '96×96 patch resolution' reference that contradicts the correct [28,28,3] structured value; llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8/ollama, limiting bit-exact reproducibility of LLM-assisted narrative steps. Neither issue affects the deterministic ML pipeline or the architectural recommendations. The representation_plan's inclusion of 'vflip' as an augmentation is worth a downstream sanity check (histopathology patches may have anatomical orientation), but this is outside the architecture_research scope. No deterministic findings. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: data_profile.ambiguity_risks narrative text references '96×96 patch resolution' while structured image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; narrative-only inconsistency, structured data is correct

llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama) across ingestion and profiling artefacts; LLM-assisted narrative steps lack bit-exact reproducibility, though the deterministic pipeline is fully pinned via code_sha256 and seed
representation_plan lists 'vflip' as an augmentation; for H&E histopathology patches, vertical flip may not preserve anatomical validity—worth verifying in the training stage
